name: security-jwe-decryption-boundary-review
intent: JWE key/algorithm/context selection and decryption error handling
artifacts: JOSE library/version, allowed algorithms, key selection, authenticated headers and downstream plaintext consumer.
trace: Trace untrusted protected/unprotected header choices into key/algorithm use and then into a purpose-specific validated payload.
experiment: Use local synthetic keys/ciphertexts and bounded valid/invalid cases; compare intended context with a wrong purpose/key/algorithm path without recovering production plaintext.
disproof: Different error messages alone do not prove a practical decryption oracle; decrypted bytes accepted for another purpose need separate evidence.
repair: Constrain algorithms/keys/context and uniform failure handling, retesting valid messages and prohibited combinations.
branch_decisions: Bind key selection and allowed alg/enc values to the recipient/context rather than trusting header choices. Successful decryption authenticates the ciphertext under a key, not necessarily its sender or tenant. Inspect any nested signature and application claims separately; differing local error text alone does not demonstrate an exploitable remote oracle.
